The '''palace''' of a rich [[Unidentified trader (Cold War)|enslaver]] was one of many such structures on [[Zygerria Four]] that was abandoned during the [[Bombardment of Zygerria Four|bombardment]] of Zygerria Four during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Scavengers recovered a wealth of goods from the palace.<ref name="In the Wake" />
